verdict.rationale: Glama's pricing page claims workflows can be automated using webhooks, which are event triggers, or schedules. This is a single marketing line with no documentation of how rules are defined, what events are supported, or what actions can run. Schedules are recurring time-based runs, not event-driven rules, so only the webhook part maps to this story. Missing for 10: documented rule/trigger definition, a catalog of supported event types and actions, conditional logic, workflow docs, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Automate workflows using schedules or webhooks.
